取消原因类型 INFORMATION_INCORRECT(&quot;信息填错: Cancellation reason type: INFORMATION_INCORRECT("Information entered incorrectly (time/address etc. needs to be changed)"), WANT_TO_SEND_MYSELF("Want to go to a nearby service point to send it myself"), PLAN_CHANGED("Plans changed, no need to ship for now"), WANT_TO_CHANGE_PICKUP_TIME("Want to change the door-to-door pickup time"), PRICE_TOO_HIGH("I think the price is a bit high"), 	ATE("Courier did not arrive for pickup on time"), COURIER_NOT_COMING("Courier does not come for pickup"), COURIER_BAD_ATTITUDE("Courier's service attitude is poor"), ITEM_CANNOT_BE_SHIPPED("Item type cannot be shipped"), COURIER_TOO_BUSY("Courier reported unable to pick up due to tight capacity"), OTHER("Other"),

下游平台,淘宝-thyny，天猫-tm，淘特-taote，阿里巴巴C2M-c2m: Downstream platform: Taobao-thyny, Tmall-tm, Taote-taote, Alibaba C2M-c2m, JD-jingdong, Pinduoduo-pinduoduo, WeChat-weixin, Cross-border-kuajing, Kuaishou-kuaishou, Youzan-youzan, Douyin-douyin, Siku-siku, Meituan Tuanhaohuo-meituan, Xiaohongshu-xiaohongshu, Dangdang-dangdang, Suning-suning, DaVdian-davdian, Xingyun-xingyun, Miya-miya, Boluopai Mall-boluo, Other-other
general（创建批发订单），fenxiao（创建分销订单）,saleprox: general (create wholesale order), fenxiao (create distribution order), the saleproxy process will verify the distribution relationship, paired (Tiantian Texmai / Daily Deals), repurchase (repurchase contract order), boutiquefenxiao (curated supply distribution-price order; used when purchase quantity is 1, free shipping applies), boutiquepifa (curated supply wholesale-price order; used when purchase quantity is greater than 2). Different order-placing flow channels may cause differences in price and purchase protection services.
单包裹发货时传的JSON字符串，cpCode 为物流公司code，对应物流公司信: JSON string passed for single-package shipment. cpCode is the logistics company code, corresponding to companyNo (not the numeric Id) from the logistics company info API; logisticsCpName: logistics company name, corresponding to companyName from the logistics company info API; mailNo: waybill number. This data can be queried via the "Logistics Company List - Self-Connected Logistics" API.
凭证图片URLs，必须使用API alibaba.trade.uploadRef: Voucher image URLs. Must use the “image domain/relative path” returned by the API alibaba.trade.uploadRefundVoucher. Up to 10 images can be uploaded; each image must not exceed 1MB; jpg, gif, jpeg, png, and bmp formats are supported. Please upload vouchers as they are required for a subsequent claim (a claim cannot be filed without them).
查询任务ID，假如货盘有10000商品，每页1000个查询10次将10000商品: Query task ID. For example, if an assortment has 10,000 products, querying 1,000 per page for 10 queries retrieves all 10,000 products; the same taskId must be passed for all 10 queries. The organization needs to fix and retain one taskId during paginated queries, then pass the same taskId each time when paging through this API.
LOGIN_ID_1688_MATCH（通过1688loginId指定对手方）、: LOGIN_ID_1688_MATCH (specify the counterparty via 1688 loginId), DRAFTER_INPUT (specify via the counterparty's entity information), COUNTERPARTY_INPUT (not specified, left for the counterparty to claim themselves)
指定要直接执行的 Workflow 名称。传入后将跳过主 Agent 的意图识别: Specifies the name of the Workflow to execute directly. When passed, the main Agent's intent recognition and planning process is skipped, and the corresponding Workflow is executed directly. If the name does not exist, the task fails.
在批量铺货时，源平台可能会为每次铺货产生一个批次传递给ISV，ISV可以在同步通: During bulk listing, the source platform may generate a batch for each listing operation and pass it to the ISV. The ISV can return this field in the sync notification. This field is passed from the platform to the ISV and is not required.
文件内容的 Base64 编码字符串，支持标准与 URL-safe 编码、dat: Base64-encoded string of the file content. Supports standard and URL-safe encoding, and a data URI prefix; the original file is recommended not to exceed 3MB.
givenByPlatform:平台赠送运费险 givenByMerchant:: givenByPlatform: shipping insurance provided by the platform; givenByMerchant: shipping insurance provided by the merchant; empty means the order has no shipping insurance
凭证图片URLs。1-5张，必须使用API uploadRefundVouche: Voucher image URLs. 1-5 images, must use the “image domain/relative path” returned by the uploadRefundVoucher API
是否打水印，是(true)或否(false)，1688无需关注此字段，1688的: Whether to add a watermark, yes (true) or no (false). 1688 does not need to be concerned with this field; 1688's watermark information is handled when the image is uploaded.
当前账号已结束（END/KILL/ERROR）的任务总数。仅当 status=Q: Total number of tasks for the current account that have ended (END/KILL/ERROR). Only returned when status=QUEUED.
仅在售中买家已收货退款退货时，可以指定小于全部。在全部退货的情况下，推荐不填写，: Can only be specified as less than the total when the in-sale buyer has received the goods and applies for a refund and return. For a full return, it is recommended not to fill this in and use the default value.
使用 complex_table.content 中的值，采购场景通常是 pur: Use the value from complex_table.content; the procurement scenario is usually purchase
证件类型 当 counterpartyOrigin = DRAFTER_INPU: ID document type; required when counterpartyOrigin = DRAFTER_INPUT
业务类型。1：商品，2：加工，3：代理，4：合作，5：商务服务。国际站按默认商品: Business type. 1: Product, 2: Processing, 3: Agency, 4: Cooperation, 5: Business service. The international site defaults to Product.
厂货通渠道专享价是否包邮，要结合非包邮地址，如果收货地址在非包邮地区则商品为不包: Whether the Changhuotong channel-exclusive price includes free shipping; must be considered together with non-free-shipping addresses — if the shipping address is in a non-free-shipping region, the product does not include free shipping.
下游渠道子业务编码，比如抖音101子渠道，用于供应链订单识别,并用于加密订单打单: Downstream channel sub-business code, e.g. Douyin sub-channel 101, used for supply chain order identification and for printing encrypted orders.
免登录公网下载地址，可直接用于 task.create 的 fileUrls。: Login-free public network download address, which can be used directly for the fileUrls of task.create.
任务类型，LONG_RUNNING表示长程任务；NORMAL表示普通对话: Task type. LONG_RUNNING indicates a long-running task; NORMAL indicates a regular conversation.
当前排队队列总长度（含本任务）。仅当 status=QUEUED 时返回: Total length of the current queue (including this task). Only returned when status=QUEUED.
榜单类型，complex综合榜，hot热卖榜，goodPrice好价榜: Ranking list type: complex (comprehensive ranking), hot (best-seller ranking), goodPrice (best-price ranking)
增量输出起始下标，首次传 0，后续传上次返回的 nextIndex: Starting index for incremental output. Pass 0 on the first call, and the nextIndex returned by the previous call on subsequent calls.
买家memberId或者buyerOpenUid（买家加密ID）: Buyer memberId or buyerOpenUid (buyer's encrypted ID)
订单Id列表,最多批量100个订单，跨境宝批量最大只支持30笔。: Order ID list. Up to 100 orders per batch; for Kuajingbao, batches support a maximum of 30 orders.
是否下游加密订单取号发货，当卖家是通过下游平台加密取号时传入Y: Whether to ship using a downstream encrypted order number; pass Y when the seller obtains the number via downstream platform encryption.
业务侧生成的任务维度id，一个任务id一定归属于一个对话id: Task-level ID generated by the business side; one task ID always belongs to one conversation ID.
没有建立铺货关系，在商品页面点击一键铺货或者调用铺货同步接口: No listing relationship has been established; click one-click listing on the product page, or call the listing sync API.
查询结束时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss: Query end time, format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
买家评价状态 (4:已评价,5:未评价,6;不需要评价): Buyer review status (4: reviewed, 5: not reviewed, 6: review not required)
备货期，单位是天，范围是1-60。1688无需处理此字段: Preparation lead time, in days, range 1-60. 1688 does not need to process this field.
调用结果 code，isSuccess=true 时关注: Call result code; relevant when isSuccess=true
物流公司编号和运单号校验不通过，检查并填写正确的运单号: Logistics company code and waybill number validation failed; check and enter the correct waybill number.
基础参数检查异常 入参为null，或入参购方id为空: Basic parameter check exception: the input parameter is null, or the input buyer id is empty.
订单总金额（单位分），一次创建多个订单时，该字段为空: Total order amount (in cents). This field is empty when multiple orders are created at once.
商品[offerId]的购买数量不满足起批量限制。: The purchase quantity for product [offerId] does not meet the minimum order quantity limit.
退款/退款退货。只有已收到货，才可以选择退款退货。: Refund / refund and return. Refund and return can only be selected once the goods have been received.
只能查询近730天的退款单，请检查退款申请时间!: Only refund orders from the last 730 days can be queried. Please check the refund application time!
数据正在后台加载，稍后重试，间隔时间建议1～3s: Data is loading in the background; please retry later. A retry interval of 1-3s is recommended.
1688的商品ID列表,列表长度不能超过20个: List of 1688 product IDs; the list length must not exceed 20.
接口请求是否成功，true成功，false失败: Whether the API request succeeded; true for success, false for failure
请求是否成功，true 成功，false 失败: Whether the request succeeded; true for success, false for failure
traceId，必须记录，排查问题提供给平台: traceId. Must be recorded and provided to the platform for troubleshooting.
库存扣减方式，1是下单减库存，2是付款减库存: Stock deduction method: 1 deducts stock upon order placement, 2 deducts stock upon payment.
超链一阶段订单的发货模式 0 仓发 1 商发: Shipping mode for Chaolian stage-one orders: 0 warehouse shipment, 1 merchant shipment
每次取的数据量，范围20-200，默认20: Number of records fetched per request, range 20-200, default 20
产品名称(退款单关联订单明细的货品名称): Product name (the item name from the order detail associated with the refund order)
供货能力周期，参见FAQ 时间周期枚举值: Supply capability cycle; see the FAQ for the time period enum values
外部机构用户id，此id为服务商平台id: External organization user id; this id is the service provider platform id
文件名称列表，与fileUrls一一对应: List of file names, corresponding one-to-one with fileUrls
订单尚未发货，暂无物流详情，请稍候再试。: The order has not been shipped yet; no logistics details are available. Please try again later.
FOB价格货币，参见FAQ 货币枚举值: FOB price currency; see the FAQ for the currency enum values

Invoice type

自动确认收货时间，仅自动确认规则下有值: Automatic receipt confirmation time; only has a value under the automatic confirmation rule.
付款方式，参见FAQ 付款方式枚举值: Payment method; see the FAQ for the payment method enum values
分页大小，不能大于100，不能小于1: Page size; must not be greater than 100 or less than 1
调用接口返回“系统繁忙，请稍后再试”: The API call returned “System busy, please try again later”
买家原始输入的退款金额(可以为空): Refund amount originally entered by the buyer (can be empty)
商品的搜索关键字，通常是商品的标题: Search keyword for the product, usually the product title

商品官方测量高度，单位cm: Officially measured product height, in cm
建议零售价，国际站无需关注: Suggested retail price; not needed for the international site

订单不存在出参示例: Example output parameter for order does not exist
